name: text-pivot-scaler
description: 文字锚点缩放动效引擎
tagline: Scale words from any anchor point.
interaction: Users click on any character or word to set a pivot anchor, then use scroll or drag to scale the text with CSS transform-origin dynamically recalculated from the selected point. The engine supports multi-axis scaling, elastic easing curves, and chained pivot transitions — creating fluid typographic motion where text breathes, stretches, and contracts around user-defined focal points.
